instruction: Change Thunderbird's reply placement so responses are shown under the quoted email text for my account.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing reply position to below quoted text. The evaluator checks that mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top is set to 0 (replies below) instead of 1 (replies on top). Current value in profile is 1, so agent needs to change it to 0. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.
metadata.verification: Verified by reading prefs.js from cache: mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top is currently 1 (on top). Task asks to place replies below (value should be 0).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: check_thunderbird_prefs metric validates that mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top equals 0 (replies below quoted text)
Complete coverage: The evaluator checks the exact Thunderbird preference that controls reply positioning
Correct expected value: Expected value of 0 is semantically correct (0=replies below, 1=replies on top), confirmed by metadata analysis
Proper postconfig: Thunderbird is closed before reading prefs.js, ensuring the file is properly flushed to disk
Data flow is sound: get_vm_file retrieves prefs.js from VM, check_thunderbird_prefs parses and validates the preference value
Metric handles None gracefully: check_thunderbird_prefs returns 0.0 if result is None (file.py:41-42)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Static type annotation warning exists (get_vm_file returns Union[Optional[str], List[Optional[str]]] while check_thunderbird_prefs expects str), but this doesn't affect runtime correctness since get_vm_file returns a single string path when multi=False
